description: This Java class defines a deserializer component for handling and validating JSON input for 'code' commands within the Apache Fineract platform, specifically processing API requests related to code creation and updates.

classes.name: CodeCommandFromApiJsonDeserializer
classes.description: A final class annotated as a Spring component that deserializes and validates JSON input for 'code' API commands, supporting create and update operations with parameter validation.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for creating a 'code' object, ensuring required fields are present and conform to constraints.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for updating a 'code' object, checking for optional fields and validating their correctness.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if any errors were accumulated during validation checks.
